Definition: multiplicative adverb from G4002; five times:--five times.
BiblicalUsage: Pentakis means five times. Paul says the Jews gave him forty stripes save one, five times — the mark of a suffering servant, counted and remembered.
TheologicalSignificance: I am sure that God counts the stripes His servants bear, and none of the five is forgotten.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
